input.title: Saint Michael the Archangel
input.text: Holy Michael, Archangel, defend us in the day of battle; be our safeguard against the wickedness and snares of the devil. May God rebuke him, we humbly pray; and do thou, prince of the heavenly host, by the power of God, thrust down to hell Satan and all wicked spirits, who roam through the world seeking the ruin of souls. Amen.
input.name: Traditional English · Lasance 1911
input.context: This historical English wording begins “Holy Michael, Archangel” and differs from familiar modern translations. Preserve it as this named version; do not silently modernize or mix translations. Underlying prayer text transcribed from 1911 US publication; public domain in the United States. input.title: Sancte Michael Archangele
input.text: Sancte Michael Archangele, defende nos in proelio; contra nequitiam et insidias diaboli esto praesidium. Imperet illi Deus, supplices deprecamur, tuque, Princeps militiae caelestis, Satanam aliosque spiritus malignos, qui ad perditionem animarum pervagantur in mundo, divina virtute, in infernum detrude. Amen.
